entries.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: one pixel-art RPG battle sprite, Tobari defense / block pose.
Input image 1 is the exact approved Tobari attack frame and is the edit target. Preserve its character identity, outfit, palette, pixel density, scale and placement.
Primary request: change only the character's pose from ready/attack to a single readable braced DEFENSE pose. Tobari lowers her weight a few pixels, bends both knees, tucks her chin and grips the long scythe shaft in both hands in front of her upper torso to parry. Her hands and shaft clearly form a defensive barrier. Keep both boots firmly planted. Keep the same giant pale crescent scythe, delicate silver-grey long twin-tail hair, dark rose hair ornaments, black dress with ivory frills, pale face, tiny muted-red eyes, no mouth.
Composition and exact invariants: maintain the reference 3:2 canvas and all transparent margins. The full image represents a 192 x 128 game cell, or a 5x enlarged 960 x 640 reference. The shared foot pivot is (99,116) in the small cell, equivalently (495,580) in the reference. The boot soles must remain at y=580 in 960x640, centered around x=495. Do not enlarge or recenter the sprite to fill the image. Keep the actual character body approximately 52 game pixels tall (260 in reference), with top of head around y=320 and feet y=580; a slight crouch is allowed, not a change in anatomical scale. Preserve character body width and head size. Scythe fits in the existing ample left and upper transparent space.
Style: match this exact low-resolution sprite, crisp clustered pixels, restrained dark mauve greys and dusty ivory, no vector smoothing, no painterly high-detail redesign.
Output: one complete single sprite on true transparent background, same framing as input, no backdrop, no floor, no cast shadow, no sparks, no particles, no shield aura, no lettering, no grid, no reference inset. Preserve the existing transparency.

Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: one pixel-art RPG battle sprite, Tobari hit / hurt reaction pose.
Input image 1 is the exact approved Tobari attack frame and is the edit target. Preserve its character identity, outfit, palette, pixel density, scale and placement.
Primary request: change only the pose to a single clear impact reaction, as if hit from the right. Both feet stay planted, the upper torso recoils subtly to the left, shoulders twist, chin tilts away, eyes squeeze shut into tiny short pixel marks, and one hand is close to the chest while the other still grips the scythe. The scythe dips slightly and the long hair swings to the right. This is a brief non-graphic hurt reaction, not death, not falling, not attacking. No blood, injury marks, hit flashes or particles.
Preserve her huge pale crescent scythe, silver-grey long twin-tail hair, dark rose hair ornaments, black dress with ivory frills, pale face, no mouth. Keep the same anatomical body proportions.
Composition and exact invariants: preserve the reference's full 3:2 transparent canvas and large empty margins. A 192 x 128 game cell is shown at 5x size, 960 x 640. The shared boot-ground pivot is (99,116), or (495,580) in the reference. Boot soles stay at y=580, centered around x=495. Do not enlarge or recenter the sprite. The character's head-to-foot height is about 52 game pixels (260 at reference size); head around y=320, feet around y=580. Keep scale identical to input. The crescent weapon may tilt within the available left/upper space but no parts should clip.
Style: match this exact low-resolution muted pixel sprite, crisp chunky pixel clusters rather than smooth illustration. Dark mauve-grey and dusty ivory; same head and hair ornament scale.
Output: only a single sprite on actual transparent background, clean alpha with no glow or haze. No ground, no cast shadow, no backdrop, no text, no grid, no inset, no extra character. Preserve transparency.
